description: Use when you need timezone conversion between time zones, the current time in a zone or a utc offset with daylight saving. Do not use for places given only by city or address without an IANA zone name, or dates before 1970. Returns JSON converting a date and time between IANA time zones with daylight saving rules, with UTC offsets, abbreviations and the current time in each zone, from the IANA tz database for 0.003 USDC per call. Typical response time 500 ms (p95). Category: Data. Price: US$0.003 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

from.description: IANA time zone of a local time, e.g. America/Sao_Paulo (UTC when omitted)

time.description: Date and time to convert, ISO 8601: local wall time like 2026-10-17T15:30 (read in the from zone) or an instant with Z or an offset; now when omitted

to.description: IANA time zones to convert to, e.g. ["Europe/London", "Asia/Tokyo"]

name: blackwood_timezone_convert
title: Time zones
